definitions.training_loss: Per-update batch CE: mean nominal transitions within each example, then mean examples; 26-symbol vocabulary, natural logarithms.
definitions.validation_loss: Same example-mean CE on a fixed cohort of 192 held-out graphs at requested depths 1–6.
definitions.trajectory_accuracy: An example succeeds only if every nominal intermediate prediction is correct. Cohorts: depths 1–6, 192 graphs; depth 7, 32; depth 8, 32.
definitions.smoothing: Display only: trailing example-weighted mean over the selected number of optimizer updates; partial windows at the start. Raw training losses retained. Validation never smoothed.
definitions.checkpoint_2500: Retained depth-extension candidate from subsequent development evaluations; not selected by the small monitor curves alone.
